title: Guided by Gut: Efficient Test-Time Scaling with Reinforced Intrinsic Confidence
authors_zh: Amirhosein Ghasemabadi（阿尔伯塔大学）、Keith G. Mills（路易斯安那州立大学）、Baochun Li（多伦多大学）、Di Niu（阿尔伯塔大学）
paper_type_zh: 高效置信度引导测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 希望以低显存部署推理搜索、并需判断模型内部不确定性能否替代独立验证器的读者。
one_line: Guided by Gut calibrates a model’s own step confidence with GRPO and uses it to guide lightweight tree search without a process reward model.
Guided by Gut 先用 GRPO 校准模型自身的步骤置信度，再以它引导轻量树搜索，无需在推理时调用过程奖励模型。
why: It makes confidence calibration a deployment decision: a smaller model can spend inference compute on promising branches instead of paying to score every branch with an external model.
inclusion_reason: It directly redistributes test-time search budget using an internally calibrated step signal, replacing external verifier inference with a lower-memory confidence-guided search policy.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Inference-time search can raise a small language model’s reasoning accuracy, but the usual routes are expensive. Best-of-N retains many long completions, while process reward model search adds another model that must be evaluated at each reasoning step. Both approaches consume GPU memory and compute precisely when the serving system is already handling multiple long chains.

The paper asks whether a reasoning model can decide which partial paths deserve more inference budget using feedback it already contains. Raw next-token probability is not automatically a trustworthy correctness estimate, so the problem is not merely to expose confidence. The signal must be calibrated enough to rank step candidates, preserve useful exploration, and do so without inserting a separate verifier into the inference path.

推理时搜索能够提升小型语言模型的推理准确率，但常用路线代价很高。最佳候选采样要保留许多长完成结果，而过程奖励模型搜索还要在每个推理步骤调用另一个模型。两种方法都会在服务系统已同时处理多条长推理链时继续消耗 GPU 显存和算力。

论文研究推理模型能否利用自身已有的反馈，决定哪些部分路径值得继续投入推理预算。原始的下一个词元概率并不会天然成为可靠的正确性估计，因此问题不只是暴露置信度。该信号必须被校准到足以排序步骤候选、保留有价值的探索，同时又不能在推理链路中额外插入一个独立验证器。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Guided by Gut treats the model’s own probability assigned to a completed reasoning step as an intrinsic, imperfect estimate of that step’s value. Instead of asking an external process reward model to score every branch, it runs a lightweight diverse tree search and ranks branches with intrinsic confidence together with a novelty term, so the search is neither blind sampling nor a single greedy chain.

The important move is to train the confidence signal for its eventual decision role. A GRPO stage rewards correct solutions whose confidence agrees with correctness and penalizes confident wrong solutions. At deployment, the calibrated model carries both the generator and the guide: search capacity is concentrated on branches that it judges promising, while novelty keeps the tree from repeatedly spending tokens on near-duplicate reasoning.

Guided by Gut 将模型为完整推理步骤分配的自身概率，视为该步骤价值的一种内在但并不完美的估计。它不再要求外部过程奖励模型给每个分支打分，而是运行轻量的多样化树搜索，并用内在置信度和新颖度项共同排序分支，因此搜索既不是盲目采样，也不是单一的贪心推理链。

关键变化在于让置信度信号适应它最终承担的决策角色。一个 GRPO 阶段奖励正确且置信度与正确性一致的解，并惩罚高置信度的错误解。部署时，经校准的模型同时承担生成器与引导器：搜索容量集中给它判断为有希望的分支，而新颖度则避免树反复把词元花在几乎重复的推理上。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors adapt Diverse Verifier Tree Search to step-delimited chains of thought. At each expansion, the model proposes step completions, derives a confidence score from its output probabilities, measures branch novelty, and uses the combined score to choose which branches continue. The search stops on a maximum depth or token limit, a final answer, or detectable text degeneration; final candidates are aggregated with confidence-weighted voting.

Before this search is used, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B and 7B models are LoRA fine-tuned with GRPO on 817 LIMO mathematical examples. The reward is designed to separate confidence on correct and incorrect outputs rather than simply reward final correctness. Experiments compare matched 32- and 64-path budgets against chain-of-thought, Best-of-N, and several process reward models on AIME, MATH500, AMC, and a small transfer test on LiveCodeBench.

作者把多样化验证器树搜索改造成面向有步骤边界的思维链。在每次扩展时，模型提出步骤完成结果，从输出概率导出置信度分数，衡量分支新颖度，再用组合分数决定哪些分支继续。搜索会在达到最大深度或词元限制、得到最终答案、或检测到文本退化时停止；最终候选则以置信度加权投票汇总。

在使用该搜索之前，作者以 817 个 LIMO 数学样例对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B 和 7B 做 LoRA 与 GRPO 微调。奖励的设计目标是拉开正确和错误输出上的置信度，而非只奖励最终正确性。实验在 AIME、MATH500、AMC 和 LiveCodeBench 的小型迁移测试上，以匹配的 32 路与 64 路预算，对比思维链、最佳候选采样和多个过程奖励模型。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On AIME 2024/2025, the 7B Guided by Gut model at 32 paths reaches 73.3% and 53.3%, exceeding the reported chain-of-thought scores of much larger 32B models on both sets and approaching the 70B comparison. At 64 paths it reaches 76.7% and 53.3%. Against matched Best-of-N, its 1.5B and 7B variants match or improve the reported average accuracy across AIME, MATH500, and AMC while using about half as much KV-cache memory.

The paper also isolates the cost of an external scorer. With Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct, intrinsic-guided search reaches 65.0% on AMC23 at 32 paths, compared with 60.0% to 63.3% for the three listed process reward models, while using 5 GB rather than 23–25 GB and about one eighth of their inference time. The confidence-reward ablation improves AIME24 score from 54.5% without RL to 58.9%; a math-calibrated 1.5B model also rises from 16.5% to 20.1% on LiveCodeBench.

在 AIME 2024/2025 上，7B 的 Guided by Gut 模型以 32 路搜索达到 73.3% 和 53.3%，超过文中报告的更大 32B 思维链模型在两个集合上的分数，并接近 70B 对照模型。以 64 路搜索时，它达到 76.7% 和 53.3%。在与最佳候选采样匹配的预算下，1.5B 与 7B 版本在 AIME、MATH500 和 AMC 上的平均准确率持平或更高，同时只使用约一半的 KV 缓存显存。

论文还单独分离了外部评分器的代价。对 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct，内在信号引导搜索在 32 路时于 AMC23 达到 65.0%，而列出的三个过程奖励模型为 60.0% 到 63.3%，且前者使用 5 GB、后者使用 23–25 GB，推理时间约为后者的八分之一。置信度奖励消融将 AIME24 分数从无 RL 的 54.5% 提升至 58.9%；只在数学上校准的 1.5B 模型在 LiveCodeBench 上也从 16.5% 升至 20.1%。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This work does not merely use self-confidence as a final answer filter. It makes step-level intrinsic confidence the control signal for a branching search procedure and explicitly trains that signal to distinguish justified confidence from overconfident errors. That shifts the model’s internal probability from a passive diagnostic into a resource-allocation mechanism that determines where further decoding occurs.

It also argues for an operational substitute for verifier-heavy search rather than only presenting a new score. The comparison keeps the same tree-search family while replacing the external PRM with confidence and a cheap novelty proxy, then reports accuracy together with wall-clock time, GPU memory, and KV-cache use. This makes the claimed benefit about serving efficiency as well as reasoning quality.

这项工作并非只把自置信度用于最终答案过滤。它让步骤级内在置信度成为分支搜索过程的控制信号，并明确训练该信号去区分有根据的自信与过度自信的错误。由此，模型内部概率从被动诊断指标变成资源分配机制，决定哪些位置值得继续解码。

它还提出了验证器密集型搜索的可运行替代方案，而不只是给出一个新分数。对比保持同一类树搜索，同时用置信度和廉价的新颖度代理替换外部过程奖励模型，并同时报告准确率、实际推理时间、GPU 显存和 KV 缓存占用。因此其声称的优势既关于推理质量，也关于服务效率。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The strongest evidence is concentrated on mathematical reasoning, and the calibration stage itself uses LIMO mathematics; the LiveCodeBench transfer is encouraging but small. Intrinsic probability can remain poorly calibrated under distribution shift, the search needs several hyperparameters such as branching and novelty weight, and the reported comparison does not establish that every proprietary or domain-specific verifier can be replaced. The paper also does not release a dedicated implementation repository, so exact engineering reproduction requires reconstructing the described search on top of its cited components.
最强的证据集中在数学推理，校准阶段本身也使用 LIMO 数学数据；LiveCodeBench 的迁移结果虽有启发性，但规模较小。内在概率在分布偏移下仍可能校准不佳，搜索还需要设置分支数和新颖度权重等多个超参数，文中的对比也不能证明每一种私有或领域专用验证器都可被替代。论文没有发布专门的实现仓库，因此要精确复现工程细节，需在其引用的组件之上重建所描述的搜索过程。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when an inference service can afford several candidate paths but cannot afford a separately served PRM for each step. It is especially useful for testing whether confidence calibration and small-beam search can trade a modest one-time fine-tuning cost for lower recurring latency and memory. Treat the reported LIMO link as a training-data dependency, not evidence that the paper releases a new benchmark or a ready-to-run search package.
当推理服务能够承担若干候选路径、却无法为每个步骤再部署一个独立过程奖励模型时，可使用这篇论文。它尤其适合检验置信度校准与小束搜索能否以一次性的微调成本，换取更低的持续延迟和显存占用。应把文中给出的 LIMO 链接视为训练数据依赖，而不是论文发布了新基准或可直接运行搜索包的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the calibration reward and the no-RL/PRM ablations before treating the headline model-size comparison as causal evidence. The most reusable claim is narrower: a model’s internal step confidence can become a practical search signal when trained to penalize confident mistakes and combined with diversity. For deployment, reproduce the comparison under the intended latency, KV-cache, and model-serving constraints rather than selecting it by accuracy alone.
在把醒目的模型规模对比视为因果证据之前，应先阅读校准奖励以及无 RL、过程奖励模型的消融实验。最可复用的结论更窄：当训练中惩罚高置信度错误并结合多样性时，模型的内部步骤置信度可以成为实际可用的搜索信号。部署时应在目标延迟、KV 缓存和模型服务约束下复现对比，而不要只按准确率选择方案。
